units.title: Unit 1: Place Value, Rounding & Multi-Digit Arithmetic

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Place Value & Rounding Multi-Digit Numbers
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Place Value & Rounding to Nearest 100 and 1,000
lessons.reading: In the base-ten system, each place value represents 10 times the value to its right. To round a multi-digit number to a target place (such as the nearest hundred or thousand), inspect the digit immediately to the right: if it is 5 or greater, round up; if it is 4 or less, round down and replace all digits to the right with zeros.

principles.title: Rounding to Nearest Hundred and Thousand
principles.summary: Look one place to the right of the rounding place: 5 or more rounds up; 4 or less stays the same.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Multi-Digit Addition & Subtraction with Regrouping
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Adding & Subtracting Multi-Digit Whole Numbers
lessons.reading: When adding or subtracting multi-digit numbers using the standard algorithm, align digits by place value (ones, tens, hundreds, thousands). Regroup 10 of a smaller unit into 1 of the next larger unit when adding, or decompose 1 larger unit into 10 smaller units when subtracting.

principles.title: Standard Algorithm for Multi-Digit Addition & Subtraction
principles.summary: Align place values vertically and regroup across tens, hundreds, and thousands.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Exam: Place Value & Multi-Digit Fluency
lessons.reading: This Unit Exam assesses both rounding multi-digit numbers and fluent multi-digit addition and subtraction.

principles.title: Rounding to Nearest Hundred and Thousand
principles.summary: Inspect the digit to the right of the target place to round accurately.

principles.title: Standard Algorithm for Multi-Digit Addition & Subtraction
principles.summary: Fluently add and subtract multi-digit whole numbers.

units.title: Unit 2: Multiplication & Division of Whole Numbers

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Multiplying 2-Digit Numbers by Area Model & Partial Products
lessons.reading: To multiply two 2-digit numbers such as 24 × 16, decompose each factor into tens and ones: (20 + 4) × (10 + 6). Multiply each part to find the four partial products, then add them together.

principles.title: Two-Digit Multiplication via Partial Products
principles.summary: Decompose factors by place value, multiply partial products, and sum the results.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Division with Remainders & Partial Quotients
lessons.reading: Division finds how many equal groups fit into a dividend. When a dividend is not a multiple of the divisor, the leftover amount is the remainder (R), which must always be strictly less than the divisor: Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder.

principles.title: Quotients and Remainders
principles.summary: Verify division using Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder, with Remainder < Divisor.

lessons.title: Unit 2 Exam: Multiplication & Division Mastery
lessons.reading: Demonstrate mastery of two-digit multiplication and division with remainders.

principles.title: Two-Digit Multiplication via Partial Products
principles.summary: Decompose factors by place value and add partial products.

principles.title: Quotients and Remainders
principles.summary: Divide whole numbers and interpret remainders.

units.title: Unit 3: Equivalent Fractions, Decimals & Geometric Measurement

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Equivalent Fractions & Adding Like Fractions
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Equivalent Fractions & Adding Fractions
lessons.reading: Multiplying both the numerator and denominator of a fraction by the same nonzero whole number creates an equivalent fraction (a/b = (n×a)/(n×b)). To add fractions with the same denominator, add the numerators and keep the common denominator.

principles.title: Generating Equivalent Fractions
principles.summary: Multiply or divide numerator and denominator by the same nonzero number.

principles.title: Adding Fractions with Like Denominators
principles.summary: Add numerators while keeping the like denominator unchanged.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Decimal Notation & Area/Perimeter of Rectangles
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Decimals as Fractions & Area/Perimeter
lessons.reading: Decimals with two digits after the decimal point represent hundredths (0.47 = 47/100). In geometry, the perimeter of a rectangle is the distance around its boundary (P = 2L + 2W), while its area is the number of square units inside (A = L × W).

principles.title: Decimals and Fractions in Tenths & Hundredths
principles.summary: Convert between decimal notation and fractions with denominators of 10 or 100.

principles.title: Area and Perimeter Formulas for Rectangles
principles.summary: Use Area = L × W and Perimeter = 2(L + W) to solve measurement problems.

lessons.title: Unit 3 Exam: Fractions, Decimals & Geometry
lessons.reading: Comprehensive assessment of equivalent fractions, like-denominator addition, decimals, and rectangle area/perimeter.

principles.title: Adding Fractions with Like Denominators
principles.summary: Combine numerators over a shared denominator.

principles.title: Decimals and Fractions in Tenths & Hundredths
Area and Perimeter Formulas for Rectangles
principles.summary: Distinguish square units of area from linear units of perimeter.
